text:
"bucket list" parties and events that are actually worth the time and energy during ur 20's/30's

5. oktoberfest with locals - if u go with just ur dumb pals, u only get like 20% of the experience

4. full moon party - this is just such a bizarre and unique experience that u must see it once in ur life (and thailand in general)

3. yacht week croatia - ditto unique, like an event that u would never experience otherwise (because ur with like 50 other yachts on the trip). also its not super expensive for what u get

[when I say unique, I mean unique...like, u can always go to nyc or miami or ibiza, they're not unique]

2. pamplona running with the bulls. prob better with locals (as all things are) but people are so goddam friendly, ur just rocking with whoever. 

1. burning man. pretty clear #1 on every level, for the most unique/insane party on earth 

first off its a fucking pain in the ass to make happen. u cant just buy a ticket solo or with a few of ur boys and show up...not only are tix are hard to get + expensive, but the amount of logistics involved is insane.

I had a friend hit me w/ a last minute dropout, I bought a flight on the spot, otherwise it never wouldve happened

have to keep ur ears open, find a crew that has an annual thing going and find a way to squeeze in...I ended up going again a 2nd year. but like...it is not comfy, its not for everyone, u must be okay with roughing it for a week. which most ppl arent (understandably)

and preferably u are a solo + worldly type of cat who doesnt mind just getting lost and wandering around and meeting new people

so theres like a city scenester type that would never want to go and doesnt go...sleeping in an RV, no showers, pass. (again, understandably)

u add all that together...and like, I'm not an "exclusivity" elitist snob, its that if u are there, u are COMMITTED.  takes enormous effort to get there and u are just way out ur comfort zone

and thats why its by far the greatest party and prob most insane event you'll go to in ur life

--

these are all best in 20's/30's, u want to "be" the party, toasted on booze and drugs, and not the slightly-too-old guy...its all love if you are, its just not optimal

some u can do older, pamplona theres a 1000% chance I go back, hopefully multiple times...hopefully die there someday, impaled on a goddamn horn, how else would u want to go out

all that other shit like mykonos, those are always a flight away...these ones take effort.

for skiers, add folie douce in meribel to the list.

thats about all I got
